title: Hill reps, 6x3min
terrain: mountain climb, 8-12% grade, ~270m D+ total, walk-down recoveries

steps.target: Z4-Z5 climb, 171-180 bpm, running not hiking

coachNotes: Dose two of the above-threshold progression: 5 reps on 13 Aug, 6 here, 5x4min on 27 Aug, then 6x90s sharp in the taper. Adding a rep rather than lengthening them, because the point is repeatable quality and the sustained-climbing stimulus is already covered by Saturday. First mountain week, so pick a climb you can rep cleanly at 8-12%, not something so steep it forces a hike. Walk every recovery, full 3min. Stop the set if a rep is more than 10s slower than rep 1. Saturday is 195 load, so this must not leave residue: if you finish the sixth rep and it felt like a fight, log it and I will cut 27 Aug. Same ladder as last week, green all 6, amber 5, red flat 40min plus strides.
